reply_text:
*I’d hold the merge.* Reviewed `idle-timeout` (`da785f6`) against `main` (`91438e5`).

• *[P1] Sessions expire after 30 milliseconds, not 30 minutes* — `src/idle.js:1–4`. `lastSeen` and `now` are millisecond timestamps, but `IDLE_TIMEOUT` is `30` rather than `1_800_000`. I reproduced a session last touched **31 ms ago** being classified idle and removed by `sweep`. This would log people out on the next sweep almost immediately after activity.

• *[P2] The exact expiration boundary is excluded* — `src/idle.js:4`. The strict `< now` comparison keeps a session active at exactly its timeout, contrary to the documented “once … 30-minute timeout” behavior. After correcting the units, the comparison should include equality.

*Validation:* All 4 existing tests pass, but they only cover just-touched and long-idle sessions, so they miss these defects. Add cases immediately before, exactly at, and immediately after 30 minutes, plus a sweep case retaining a recently active session.

No files changed.
